case_name: Add a logo or text overlay
title: Subtle Handle Watermark Throughout
tests: Tests exact handle rendering as a persistent, readable, translucent watermark without changing the source footage or audio.

judge.summary: The output shows a subtle, readable @flightschool watermark consistently inset at the bottom right, with no visible watermarking defects.

must_haves.item: The watermark reads exactly '@flightschool' and stays visible throughout the entire clip.
must_haves.why: The handle is spelled correctly and visible in all four output samples spanning the clip.

must_haves.item: The handle remains fixed at the bottom right with clear space between the text and both frame edges.
must_haves.why: Its position is consistent across the samples, with clear bottom and right margins.

must_haves.item: The text is small, white, visibly translucent, and readable against the changing footage, with a subtle shadow.
must_haves.why: The small, softened white text has a faint dark shadow and remains readable across both cockpit views.

must_haves.item: The original cockpit footage remains unchanged apart from the watermark, with no extra card or scene.
must_haves.why: The matching cockpit view appears consistent with the source frame, and no extra card is shown, but one source frame cannot establish whether every shot and the visible subtitles were preserved unchanged.

must_haves.item: The output lasts 7 seconds and preserves the original synchronized audio.
must_haves.why: The supplied information confirms a 7-second output with speech, but no original audio or synchronization comparison is provided.
